Notes

Limitations: Collapses and simplifies response categories to standardize across years. See individual year’s datasets for details. Some response categories are still not standardized. For example, “I plan to vote before Election Day” is unavailable in 2016. Additionally, the question is available in years 2010 and earlier but not included in this version of the cumulative dataset because those years rely on a 2006–2012 cumulative release.
